description: Open questions for PRD gaps in prd/traceability.json, asked one at a time by the grill-prd skill. An answered question records who decided, when, and what changes. Run npm run prd:grill for the next question.

questions.question: The reason must explain why the employee missed the two shuttles that caused the block, not why they need the new trip. Which reasons are valid for those missed shuttles?
options: Only emergencies: medical emergency and family emergency; drop client visit (Recommended)
Keep all three: medical emergency, family emergency, and an unplanned client visit that made them miss the shuttle
questions.answer: Keep all three: medical emergency, family emergency, and an unplanned client visit that made them miss the shuttle. WorkRide books office shuttle seats only, so the reason is for the missed shuttles, never for the new trip.
questions.action: Revised prd/workride-chat-prd.md and booking-policies.md; the chat bot asks why the shuttles were missed; bookings record override_no_show_ids from getBlockingNoShows(); CHAT-08 added to prd/traceability.json with tests that fail on trip-reason wording.

questions.question: When must the API require a Trimble ID token, so email sign-in can no longer reach booking and admin actions?
options: Before the pilot with real employees (Recommended)
Before production launch; the pilot keeps dev email login on localhost only

questions.question: While an employee is blocked, does "chat may book one trip" mean one urgent chat booking for the whole block, or one per valid urgent request?
options: One urgent chat booking per block; add a limit (Recommended)
One per valid urgent request; reword the chat PRD
One urgent chat booking per day of the block; add a limit

questions.question: Should bookings and cancels use the signed-in employee instead of the user_id sent in the request?
options: Yes, together with the Trimble ID token check (Recommended)
Yes, now, from the dev session, before Trimble ID is enforced

questions.question: Should the API enforce admin-only access to the day view, vehicle tag, and no-show actions, and hide the Admin tab from employees?
options: Yes, together with the Trimble ID token check (Recommended)
Yes, now, using is_admin on the signed-in user

questions.question: The baseline PRD is Agreed and does not say weekends and listed public holidays cannot be booked. How should the rule be added?
options: Write a change PRD that adds it to the baseline (Recommended)
Add it when the baseline PRD is next revised and re-agreed

questions.question: The chat PRD says "a Chat page", but chat shipped as a floating chat bot on every page. Which is right?
options: The floating chat bot; reword the chat PRD (Recommended)
A separate Chat page; build it and keep the PRD wording
